name: 2D Texture-Based Volume Rendering with Z-Slice Packing
definition: A volume rendering technique that stores a 3D volume as a 2D texture composed of a grid of Z-slices, allowing 3D sampling via 2D texture lookups and trilinear interpolation.
summary: 2D Texture-Based Volume Rendering with Z-Slice Packing stores 3D scalar fields in a 2D Z-slice grid to enable efficient GPU sampling via 2D texture lookups, distinct from tiled storage by using a fixed grid layout for standard bilinear filtering.
